title: Gold Leaf Mix Solo 5-Color #02 (대각 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 30s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, high ponytail swept sleek — her body is covered in applied metallic leaf in 5 different colours at once, each colour claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 diagonal bands by 4 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 14% of the way down her figure from the top, about 41% of the way down her figure from the top, about 58% of the way down her figure from the top and about 75% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries applied BRIGHT SILVER metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright BRIGHT SILVER sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied COPPER metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright COPPER sheen filling every gap. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries applied RUBY RED metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright RUBY RED sheen filling every gap. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries applied AMETHYST VIOLET metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright AMETHYST VIOLET sheen filling every gap. Region 5 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries applied CHAMPAGNE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright CHAMPAGNE sheen filling every gap. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring leaf colours dissolve into each other, flakes from one thinning out as flakes from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one colour, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots covered in the same leaf colours at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every leaf sheet and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
